proof.command: cd packages/dispatch && bun run e2e -- --project=firefox e2e/keyboard-session-pickers.e2e.ts --repeat-each=4 (server without and with the fix); bun run e2e -- --project=firefox (whole project); bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --project=iphone e2e/agent-view.e2e.ts e2e/agent-view-settings.e2e.ts e2e/keyboard-session-pickers.e2e.ts e2e/live.e2e.ts

Go: TestSSEStreamOpensAtOnceForABrowserWaitingOnItsFirstByte passes; the api package's stream tests pass. Evidence: https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2205#issuecomment-6409973033
proof.negativeControl: The same Firefox spec ×4 against the server without the ': open' write → 7 failed (11a ×3, 11d ×4), the rows CI failed in job 121364414957; the Go test without the write → `first body bytes = "" after 2s`.
